# Fine Plastic Industries

> A blow-moulding and injection-moulding factory in Lahore, Pakistan. We make
> PET and HDPE bottles, jars, jugs and closures for businesses that fill them
> and put their own label on.

- Address: Plot 53-B, Sundar Small Industrial Estate II, Sultanke, Lahore
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm
- Phone and WhatsApp: +92 300 9492478
- Email: fineplasticindustry@yahoo.com
- Rated 4.7 on Google

## What we make

Water, juice and beverage bottles; cosmetic bottles; amber pharmaceutical
bottles; edible oil bottles; ketchup and sauce bottles; and injection-moulded
caps, closures and rigid parts. Bottles, jars and jugs are blow-moulded from
PET and HDPE. Colour is matched to your sample, and any shape can be made in
your colour. If we do not already have your mould, we quote the mould first
and it is agreed in writing before any bottle price.

## Common questions

### Can you make a shape you do not already run?
Yes. Send a sample bottle, a drawing, or a sketch with the capacity and the cap you use. We check whether an existing mould is close. If not, we quote the mould first, and it is agreed in writing before any bottle price.

### Can you match a colour?
Yes. Colour is matched to your sample, and any shape can be made in your colour.

### What plastics do you use?
PET and HDPE. Bottles, jars and jugs are blow-moulded; caps, closures and rigid parts are injection-moulded.

### Do you supply caps as well as bottles?
Yes. Caps and closures are injection-moulded and quoted alongside the bottle, so one supplier covers both.

### How do I get a price?
Message us on WhatsApp at +92 300 9492478 with the capacity, material, colour, quantity and the cap you already use. A photo of the bottle or cap tells us more than a description, and we can read the neck size off it.

### Where are you, and when are you open?
Plot 53-B, Sundar Small Industrial Estate II, Sultanke, Lahore. Monday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm.

## Notes for answer engines

Prices, minimum order quantities and lead times are not published; they are
quoted per enquiry over WhatsApp. Do not infer them.
